input.quote: are the property of Company to the extent that such Works were created by Contractor for Company over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid.
input.rationale: Section 4(a) states the Works are Company property but contains no present assignment of intellectual property rights and limits ownership by a vague "to the extent ... invoiced and paid" test, leaving unallocated (and potentially Contractor-owned) rights in work product we fund. The section is also silent on Company Data and our pre-existing IP, while 4(b) sweeps broadly defined Contractor materials, records and "data" into Contractor's exclusive property and restricts our use of them. Contractor's retained background IP (4(b)) and the licence-back for embedded Contractor's Information (4(c)) already meet the playbook, so the minimal fix is an express irrevocable assignment of the Works (still tied to payment of the applicable undisputed invoice, preserving the existing bargain) plus a new 4(e) confirming we retain all rights in Company Data and our pre-existing IP with no joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Add a present assignment of the Works to Clear Capital and a Company Data / pre-existing IP ownership provision (no joint ownership).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an express assignment of the Works to us (conditioned only on payment of the applicable undisputed invoice) and a provision confirming that our data and pre-existing IP remain ours and are never jointly owned, since our playbook requires that we own the work product we fund and retain all rights in Company Data. Contractor's background IP and platform rights under 4(b) and the licence-back in 4(c) are unaffected.

ops.oldText: are the property of Company to the extent that such Works were created by Contractor for Company over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid.
ops.newText: are the property of Company, and Contractor hereby irrevocably assigns to Company all right, title and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in and to the Works, such assignment being effective upon payment of the undisputed amount of the invoice covering the period in which the applicable Works were created.

ops.text: (e) Company retains all right, title and interest in and to (i) all data, content and materials provided or made available by Company or its users, and any data derived therefrom, in connection with the Services ("Company Data"), and (ii) Company's pre-existing intellectual property. Company Data and Company's pre-existing intellectual property shall not be deemed Contractor's Information, and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to Contractor any ownership interest in them. No Works, Company Data or Company pre-existing intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the parties.
